name: final-ii-28l-z1r
note: Ruler final table priority (ii), 28L retrain set (torch 2.9.1 training; official eval in the pipeline venv). Code @ref-0171. Executor fills __URI_<member>__ = <retrain VM out>/babylm/runs/<member>/score/hf and __MIX_REF_pXY__ = the reads/rt28 full raw mixture DEV. GLUE is sequential (FT_PARALLEL=0): the S identity check was MISMATCH on multirc (ftverify @ref-0194), so no concurrent GLUE and no 28L identity check. Guard caveat: MIX_REF comes from the retrain VM's twin (torch 2.9.1); the guard recomputes it in the pipeline venv; a FAIL at |diff| ~1e-5..1e-4 would be a torch-eval difference, report it before voiding. bin Z1 (GLUE only): K=2 mixture p01 GLUE ens2 (m0 seed 42, m1 seed 43) via GLUE_PREV (reuses bin ZS zero-shot + guard; GLUE_RERUN=none). __ZS28_OUT__ = bin ZS synced out dir. maxdur 6. Pool ruler. EXECUTOR: project-c only. EXECUTOR 19:00Z: z1 preempted after m0 boolq; resume per ruler (GLUE_PREV=z1 out, GLUE_RERUN=none), ref-0174, + the 6 28L READING_PS jobs (moved here from z2 as the next project-c VM).
